hints.title: Rewrite the denominator
hints.body: A square root is a power of one half, so xx=x32. Split the numerator into two terms before doing any calculus.
hints.recap: Simplifying to a sum of powers makes the power rule available.
hints.pitfall: Differentiating a numerator and denominator separately does not give the derivative of their quotient.
hints.pause: Write both terms as a constant times a power of x.

recall.reminder: Simplifying to a sum of powers makes the power rule available.

hints.title: Differentiate each power
hints.body: The expression becomes 12x32−(52)x12. Use d(xn)dx=nxn−1 on each term.
hints.recap: Multiply by the old exponent, then subtract one from that exponent.
hints.pitfall: The derivative of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow></msup></mrow></math> has a negative exponent.
hints.pause: Find the two coefficients and the two new exponents.

recall.reminder: Multiply by the old exponent, then subtract one from that exponent.

hints.title: Match the fraction form
hints.body: Your derivative should have one term containing x and one containing 1x. Put them over the common denominator 4x.
hints.recap: Equivalent derivative forms can be compared after taking a common denominator.
hints.pitfall: Multiplying <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><msqrt><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow></math> by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><mrow><msqrt><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow></math> gives x, not another square root.
hints.pause: Combine the two terms and compare their numerator with the options.

recall.reminder: Equivalent derivative forms can be compared after taking a common denominator.

solution:
The original expression is defined for x>0. Since 2xx=2x32, it simplifies to 12x32−(52)x12.

Differentiate term by term to obtain (34)x12−(54)x−12. In radical form this is 3x4−54x.

Use the common denominator 4x: the first numerator becomes 3x, so the result is 3x−54x, option C.
knowledgePattern: Simplify a quotient to fractional powers before differentiation
